claims.statement: For fixed 0<eta<=1 and finite c, the universal inequality sum_i(K_i-Gamma_i)+(1+eta)U<=cI implies GU'(c+2,1-eta), U<=((c+2)/eta)I, and H<=(2+2(c+2)/eta)I.
For every genuine Boolean f, sum_i(K_i-Gamma_i)+(5/4)U(f)<=2I(f). If true it gives GU'(4,3/4) and FEI constant 34.
claims.scope: Exhaustive floating falsifier through four variables, deterministic random tests in dimensions five through nine, and selected point-defect, majority, and addressing families. No all-dimensional proof.
claims.sharpness: Exact equality on a four-bit flat-spectrum Boolean sign and all of its disjoint tensor powers.

claims.statement: The coordinate allocation Delta_iU-B_i+(5/4)u_i^*<=2 Inf_i is false for a genuine five-bit Boolean sign; mask 2624023184 and zero-based coordinate 2 give a strictly positive residual.
The remaining sufficient target is the aggregate signed refund SMR_{c,eta} for some finite c and eta>0. Coordinatewise ownership by the normalized upper-set share u_i^* is exactly obstructed.
